t: This is a statue in Queen Square, Bloomsbury, thought to be of Queen Charlotte. She was the wife of George the Third, and Queen of Great Britain and Ireland from their marriage in 1761 until her death in 1818. Through the Acts of Union in 1800 she became queen of the United Kingdom, and she was also Queen of Hanover from 1814. She served for fifty-seven years, which makes her Britain's longest-serving queen consort. The identification is only probable, but the square is generally associated with her.
